deployment.commit_message:
GAP-FILL: chair-consensus-gate.mjs's gates check rejected every real reasoning plan

HAND-AUTHORED-JUSTIFICATION: narrow correctness fix to an existing module, no
new logic invented. Live-reproduced: an auto-generated reasoning plan (the
"first ship authors from task+spec" path) failed runChairConsensusGate with
incomplete_reasoning_plan / missing:["gates"] every single time. Root cause:
deriveGates() in reasoning-plan.mjs has always returned an object of named
boolean flags ({sentry_mandatory, founder_approval_required,
blueprint_authority_required, external_research_required}) -- confirmed the
same shape is what every other real reader expects
(blueprint-generator.mjs's `reasoningPlan.gates || {}` and
`blueprint?.gates?.founder_approval_required`) -- but validatePlanFields()
here checked Array.isArray(plan.gates), which is unconditionally false for an
object. No auto-generated plan could ever have passed this check. Fixed the
outlier (this file) to match the real shape everywhere else, not the other
way around.
